title: PXAPI website evidence v1
description: Deterministic website evidence derived from measurement records for one analysis pass (Confluence 39846055 §8: the baseline pass and the targeted pass produce two instances). Every item states its assessment state explicitly: an item that was NOT_ASSESSED or whose value is UNKNOWN has polarity NOT_APPLICABLE, so a provider or runtime failure can never be expressed as a negative finding. An item that is KNOWN must reference at least one measurement record.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this evidence belongs to.

evidence_pass.description: Required. Which pass this evidence document summarises.

generated_at.description: Required. When the evidence document was generated.

target_url.description: Required. The analysed website's URL as accepted for the run.

items.description: Required. The evidence items. An empty array means no items were derived; it never means anything was not assessed — that is stated per item.

evidence_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this item; diagnosis claims reference it.

metric_id.description: Required. The metric the item is about.

subject.description: Required. What the item is about.

assessment_state.description: Required. Whether the subject was assessed at all.

value_state.description: Conditional. Present if and only if assessment_state is MEASURED or OBSERVED. Forbidden for NOT_ASSESSED.

unknown_reason.description: Conditional. Present if and only if value_state is UNKNOWN.

not_assessed_reason.description: Conditional. Present if and only if assessment_state is NOT_ASSESSED.

observation.description: Required. What was observed, in evidence language; for a NOT_ASSESSED or UNKNOWN item it states that nothing was established.

polarity.description: Required. Whether the item speaks for, against or neutrally about the website. NOT_APPLICABLE if and only if the item is NOT_ASSESSED or UNKNOWN: a missing measurement has no polarity.

measurement_refs.description: Required. The record_ids of the measurement records the item is derived from. At least one for a KNOWN item; may be empty for a NOT_ASSESSED or UNKNOWN item.

confidence.description: Required, nullable. Confidence in the item on the 0..5 scale; null if and only if assessment_state is NOT_ASSESSED.
